title: Rainbow Revolution In Agriculture
definition: The Rainbow Revolution in Indian agriculture represents an inclusive, multi-faceted strategy aimed at holistically developing agriculture, animal husbandry, forestry, fisheries, poultry, and food processing by integrating all preceding specialized color revolutions into a single, coordinated framework.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (Environment, Agriculture Schemes, Economic Survey data) and Mains GS Paper-3 (Indian Economy, Agriculture, Food Security, Inclusive Growth, Doubling Farmers' Income).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rainbow Revolution In Agriculture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
